params.name: group
params.description: The group of events to return. One of `campaign`, `settings`, or `lead_detail`.

params.name: campaign
params.description: Filters events about a specific campaign.

params.name: lead
params.description: Filters events about a certain lead.

params.name: user
params.description: Filters events performed by a certain user.

params.name: start_at
params.description: Gets events after the specified time.

params.name: end_at
params.description: Gets events before the specified time.

items.docs: Retrieves activity events. Each response contains a maximum of 500 events; when more exist, `has_more` is true and `next_page` holds the next URL.
